# Assumption of Moses Chapter 8 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Final Persecution

---

**1** And they will torment those who are righteous, punishing them, saying: let us become like them.

**2** And at that time kings from the east will rise up against them, come and seize them.

**3** A powerful king will arise, a judge of the whole earth, who will oppress them.

**4** He will be a man of power and audacity, a harsh judge who will punish those who turn away.

**5** He will crucify those who confess their ways and will put their cities to the sword.

**6** He will burn their cities with fire, and their sacred objects will be removed.

**7** He will burn their sanctuary with fire and will cut off all their heritage, eradicating the righteous from among them.

**8** They will be put to death, plundered, and tortured.

**9** Because they were not faithful they will receive punishment worthy of their wickedness.

**10** They will be punished by the sword and led away into captivity.

**11** Part of them will be destroyed and made desolate.

**12** He will come against them with great fury, and the houses of their holy ones will be thrown down.

**13** In those days there will be a tribulation such as there has been none since the beginning of the world.

**14** Even the ancient patriarchs would not have been able to endure such tribulation.

**15** Those who have been righteous will mourn for their brothers.
